blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Memorization inflates the benchmark scores of large language models (LLMs), since a model can reproduce answers it saw in training. Researchers test for it with consistent identifier renaming (CIR), which gives every identifier in a task a new name, and treat a lower score on the renamed task as evidence of recall. We test this method on the Temporal Logic of Actions Plus (TLA+) language, whose model checker acts as an oracle by confirming whether a renamed task preserves the exact behaviors of the original. Across 111 TLA+-Bench tasks, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28% to 18% and of GPT-5 from 9% to 7%. Most of this decrease comes from how the test grades, which requires exact names that most descriptions never state. Grading by behavior shrinks the decrease to about 3 percentage points for Opus 4.8 and to 0 for GPT-5. In two model families fine-tuned on disjoint halves of the tasks, renaming removes about half of the training gain in likelihood and costs 4.9 percentage points (Qwen) and 1.3 percentage points (Gemma) on unseen tasks. A lower score after renaming therefore mixes memorization, name-based grading, and the cost of new names.
blocks.zh: 记分法夸大了大型语言模型(LLM)的基准分数,因为一个模型可以复制它在训练中看到的答案. 研究人员用一致的标识符重命名(CIR)对其进行测试,使任务中的每个标识符都有一个新名称,并将重命名任务上较低的分数作为召回的证据. 我们在动作加号(TLA+)语言上测试这种方法,其模型检查器通过确认被重新命名的任务是否保留了原作的准确行为而起到神谕的作用. 在111个TRA+-Bench任务中,更名将克劳德·奥普斯4.8的正确性从28%降低到18%,将GPT-5的正确性从9%降低到7%. 这种下降大多出自测试分数的方式,这需要大多数描述从未说明的准确名字. 行为递减使Opus 4.8的下降幅度缩小到约3个百分点,而GPT-5的下降幅度为0个百分点. 在两个模范家庭内,对一半的任务进行了微调,重新命名可能使大约一半的培训收益被取消,在未见任务上花费了4.9个百分点(Quen)和1.3个百分点(Gemma)。 因此,重新命名后的分数较低,会混合记忆、基于名称的分数和新名称的成本。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: TLA + is a formal specification language engineers use to find design errors in concurrent and distributed systems before they build them, and Amazon Web Services has reported subtle bugs found this way in DynamoDB and S3 Newcombe et al. (2015) . A TLA + specification describes the possible behaviors of a system, and the TLC model checker explores every reachable state and checks the properties that a configuration file lists by name Lamport (2002) ; Yu et al. (1999) . Writing a correct specification takes time and expertise, so LLMs that write specifications from natural-language descriptions could help more engineers use the method. Benchmarks measure this by checking each generated specification with the TLA + parser SANY and the model checker TLC Cheng et al. (2026) ; Bisharat et al. (2026a) ; Bisharat et al. (2026b) .
blocks.zh: TLA +是正式的规格语言工程师在构建并发系统中发现设计出错之前,亚马逊网络服务公司(Amazon Web Services)报告了在DynamoDB和S3 Newcombe等人(2015年)中发现的微妙错误. TLA + 规格描述一个系统的可能行为, TLC 模型检查器探索每个可达到的状态并检查一个配置文件所列出的名为 Lamport(2002年) 的属性; Yu等(1999年). 写出正确的规格需要时间和专门知识,因此从自然语言描述中写出规格的LLMS可以帮助更多的工程师使用这种方法. 基准衡量方法是通过TLA + parser SANY和模型检查器TLC Cheng等人(2026年);Bisharat等人(2026年a年);Bisharat等人(2026年b年b年)检查每个生成的规格。

blocks.en: TLA + -Bench and FormaLLM take their TLA + specifications from public repositories on GitHub Bisharat et al. (2026a) ; Bisharat et al. (2026b) , so a model under test may have been trained on the specifications in these benchmarks, and a score may then measure recall as well as skill. Coding models memorize parts of their training data Yang et al. (2024) and score higher on problems that resemble their training examples Riddell et al. (2024) ; Matton et al. (2024) . Public TLA + data is scarce, since TLA + -Bench collects 1,614 candidate specifications from 13 repositories Bisharat et al. (2026b) , and it is unknown whether models recall these few specifications. Likelihood-based detectors perform near chance on training and held-out data from the same distribution Shi et al. (2024) ; Duan et al. (2024) , so researchers rename every identifier of a task consistently and compare the scores on the original and renamed tasks Wang et al. (2023) ; Le et al. (2025) ; De Koning et al. (2026) ; Gulati et al. (2025) ; Mirzadeh et al. (2025) ; Li (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026) ; Spencer et al. (2026) . We call this consistent identifier renaming (CIR) , because each identifier gets one new name everywhere it appears. The test assumes that the renamed task is as hard as the original, so a lower score after CIR is read as evidence of memorization. We study this test on TLA + , because TLC can confirm that a renamed task keeps the behaviors of the original and can grade an answer by behavior.

blocks.en: We investigate memorization in LLM-written TLA + through three experiments on 111 TLA + -Bench tasks whose renamed copies pass SANY and TLC. Experiment 1 grades the outputs of Claude Opus 4.8 Anthropic (2026) and GPT-5 OpenAI (2025) the way TLA + -Bench grades them, with the configuration file of the reference specification, which often requires names that the description never states (illustrated in Figure 1 ). Experiment 2 fine-tunes two copies each of Qwen2.5-Coder-14B and Gemma 4 31B on disjoint halves of the tasks, so each task is seen by one copy and unseen by the other, and compares the renaming decrease on seen and unseen tasks. Experiment 3 grades the outputs of Experiment 1 again by behavior, which ignores names. Together, the experiments show that a lower score after renaming has three possible causes, 1 memorization of the original task, 2 a grading practice that requires names the model is never given and 3 the extra difficulty of working with unfamiliar random names. This paper makes four contributions. 1 We show that much of the decrease after CIR on TLA + -Bench comes from the grading procedure. 2 We separate memorization from the cost of CIR with controlled fine-tuning on disjoint halves of the tasks, so the training exposure of every task is known. 3 We measure the decrease after CIR with a grade that checks behavior and ignores names. 4 We give recommendations for contamination tests and benchmark builders, and we release ALIAS, with the renamed tasks, the exposure split, all model outputs and the behavior-based grader. 1 1 1 https://github.com/LUC-AI4FM/ALIAS

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: Background. TLA + is a language that describes how a system behaves over time Lamport (2002) . A specification lists the variables of the system, the starting states and the steps that may change the variables, together with the properties that the system must satisfy (see Figure D.1 for a small clock). SANY parses the module for TLA + syntax correctness and checks that every name in a specification is defined. TLC then explores every state that a finite instance can reach and checks invariants, which must hold in every state, and temporal properties, which must hold over whole behaviors Yu et al. (1999) (see Appendix B ). A configuration file gives TLC the constant values, the specification formula and the property names. A behavior is a sequence of states, and a specification G G refines a specification R R if every behavior of G G is also a behavior of R R . TLC checks this by running G G against the formula of R R after mapping the variables of R R to those of G G .
blocks.zh: 背景情况。 TLA + 是一种描述一个系统在一段时间里如何表现出Lamport(2002年)的语言. 一个规格列出了系统的变量,起始状态和可能改变变量的步骤,以及系统必须满足的属性(小时钟见图D.1). SANY解析了 TLA + 语法正确性的模块,并检查一个规格中每个名称的定义. TLC然后探索有限实例能够到达和检查每个州必须持有的变量的每一个状态,以及必须掌握整个行为的时间属性 Yu等(1999年)(见附录B)。 一个配置文件给出了常数,规格公式和属性名. 一个行为是状态的序列,一个规格G精细化了一个规格RR,如果G的每一个行为也是RR的行为...... TLC在将 R R 的变量映射到 G G 的变量后, 对照 R R 的公式运行 G 来检查此值 。

blocks.en: TLC finds operators and constants by the names in the configuration file, so the line INVARIANT TypeOK asks TLC to check the operator called TypeOK . A TLA + -Bench task has a natural-language description, which the model receives, and a configuration file, which checks the model’s output. The human-written TLA + module behind each task is its reference specification , and the model never sees it Bisharat et al. (2026b) . An output passes only if it uses the exact name of every constant and property in the configuration file.
blocks.zh: TLC在配置文件中通过名称找到运算符和常数,因此行INVARIANT TypeOK要求TLC检查名为TypeOK的运算符. 一个 TLA + - Bench 任务有一个自然语言的描述,模型收到,还有一个配置文件,检查模型的输出. 每个任务背后的由人书写的TLA+模块是它的参考规格,模型从未看到它Bisharat等 (2026b). 输出只有在使用配置文件中每个常数和财产的确切名称时才会通过.

blocks.en: Names in Specifications. Authors of TLA + specifications often use domain concepts when selecting identifier names. Human readers understand formal specifications better with meaningful names Finney et al. (1998) . For example, in Läufer’s Microwave specification Läufer (2022) the names door , radiation and DoorSafety tie the natural language description to the formal state. The configuration file also lists names, so a check that uses it requires those exact names.
blocks.zh: 规格中的名称。 TLA+规格的作者在选择标识名称时经常使用域名. 人类读者用有意义的名字Finy等(1998年)来更好地了解正式的规格. 例如,在Läufer的微波规格Läufer(2022年)中,名称门、辐射和DoorSafety将自然语言描述与正式状态挂钩。 配置文件也列出名字,所以使用它需要这些确切名字的检查.

blocks.en: Related Work. LLMs for formal specification. Several benchmarks let a checker grade formal artifacts from LLMs Hou et al. (2024) . For TLA + , SysMoBench grades models of real systems with SANY, TLC, trace validation and invariant checks Cheng et al. (2026) . Bisharat et al. use the comments of each specification as its task description Bisharat et al. (2026a) and TLA + -Bench adds LLM-written descriptions to 403 model-checked and 897 parse-only specifications Bisharat et al. (2026b) . Interface names raise TLA + -Bench correctness up to 11-fold Bisharat et al. (2026b) . Spencer et al. rename modules to limit contamination Spencer et al. (2026) . Dafny, Lean and Verus benchmarks grade with verifiers Loughridge et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2025) , and some avoid contamination by design Yang et al. (2023) ; Xu et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: Measuring contamination. Some studies search training data for contamination Yang et al. (2024) ; Riddell et al. (2024) ; Matton et al. (2024) . Other studies control contamination by training models themselves. Magar and Schwartz pretrain BERT with chosen test sets in the corpus and separate memorization from its use on the task Magar and Schwartz (2022) , Jiang et al. pretrain GPT-2 models with test inputs or full test examples in the corpus Jiang et al. (2024) , and Carlini et al. show that memorization grows with model size and with the number of repeats of an example Carlini et al. (2023) . Our exposure experiment follows this design with fine-tuning and adds renaming. Oren et al. test whether a model prefers a benchmark’s canonical example order Oren et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 测量污染。 一些研究为杨等(2024年);Riddell等(2024年);Matton等(2024年)。 其他研究通过训练模型本身控制污染。 Magar和Schwartz预训BERT在教程中配有所选的测试套件,并在任务中将纪念与使用区分开来(Magar和Schwartz)(2022年),Jiang等人预训GPT-2型号,在"教程"(Jiang等)(2024年)和"Carlini等"中配有测试输入或完整测试实例. 显示记忆随着模型大小和一例Carlini等(2023年)的重复次数而增长. 我们的曝光实验遵循了这个设计,进行了微调并增加了更名. 奥伦等. 测试一个模型是否更喜欢基准的单词例子顺序Oren等人(2024年).

blocks.en: Perturbation and renaming. Perturbation studies change a task and keep its meaning. Code studies rename identifiers among other changes Wang et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2022) ; Xia et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) , and mathematical benchmarks change variables and constants Mirzadeh et al. (2025) ; Gulati et al. (2025) . Wu et al. note that counterfactual task variants may simply be harder Wu et al. (2024) . Le et al. remove identifier names from code-understanding tasks and find lower scores even on execution tasks Le et al. (2025) . De Koning et al. relate the decrease of each renamed program-repair task to a model’s likelihood of the original code De Koning et al. (2026) . Lean and Verus studies rename verified code Li (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026) . These studies observe decreases on models with unknown training data, so how much of a decrease comes from memory, from the grade or from the new names is unknown.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: A CIR test renames the identifiers of each reference specification, rewrites the description and configuration file with the new names and compares a model’s correctness on the two versions of each task, which we call the original and renamed conditions. We build such a test set and run three experiments on it with the same two grades (illustrated in Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: CIR测试将每个参考规格的标识符重新命名,将描述和配置文件与新名称重写,并比较模型对每个任务的两个版本的正确性,我们称之为原始和被重新命名的条件. 我们建造了这样一个测试组,并用同样的两个分数对其进行了三次实验(见图2)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The test set (top) and the three experiments (bottom), each with its models, grade and controls.
blocks.zh: 图2:测试集(上部)和三个实验(下部),每个实验都有其模型,分级和控制.

blocks.en: Dataset. We use the human-written reference specifications of the model-checked tier of TLA + -Bench Bisharat et al. (2026b) . This tier contains 403 specifications, each with a configuration file that passes TLC, and labels 146 of them as system specifications. We exclude the other 257 utility modules because they are small helpers in which our renaming affects a median of only five identifiers. Our test set contains the 111 tasks whose renamed reference specifications pass both SANY and TLC (see Table K.1 ).
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们使用经检验的模型级TLA + - Bench Bisharat等人(2026年b)的人文参考规格。 这个等级包含403个规格,每个规格有一个能通过TLC的配置文件,并将其中146个标记为系统规格. 我们排除了其他257个功能模块,因为这些模块是小的帮助者,其中我们的更名只影响5个识别符的中位数。 我们的测试集包含111项任务,其重新命名的参考规格通过SANY和TLC(见表K.1)。

blocks.en: Renaming. We replace each author-defined module name, constant, variable and operator with a random name of the same length, because SANY reads the layout of a formula (see Appendix G ). The same map renames the specification, its configuration file and every module that imports it, and SANY and TLC confirm that the renamed copy still parses and passes model checking.
blocks.zh: 重发. 我们用相同长度的随机名称来取代每个作者定义的模块名称,常数,可变和操作符,因为SANY读取了公式的布局(见附录G. 同一张地图重新命名了规格,它的配置文件以及每一个导入它的模块,而SANY和TLC则确认被重新命名的拷贝仍然在剖析和通过模型检查.

blocks.en: Renamed descriptions. Each specification in TLA + -Bench comes with a natural language description that mentions many of its operators and constants by name Bisharat et al. (2026b) . The original condition gives the LLM this description, and the renamed condition prompts the LLM with a copy of the original description in which those identifiers are replaced. Replacing every renamed identifier in the text would also change unrelated words, because authors use common words and algorithm names as identifiers (see Appendix G for the example and further details). We therefore rename each description with a fixed rule of three parts. 1 A name that the configuration refers to is always renamed, because the model needs the new name for TLC to check its output. 2 A lowercase word or a TLA + module name keeps its name. 3 Every other identifier is renamed. This rule avoids damage to 45 descriptions.
blocks.zh: 重命名描述. TLA + - Bench 中的每个规格都带有自然语言描述,其中提到许多其操作符和常数,取名 Bisharat等 (2026b). 原始条件给出了LLM的这一描述,被重新命名的条件会用替换这些标识符的原始描述的副本来提示LLM. 替换文本中每一个被重新命名的标识符也会改变不相干的单词,因为作者使用通用单词和算法名称作为标识符(示例和进一步细节见附录G). 因此,我们用三个部分的固定规则重新命名每个描述。 1个 配置中提及的名称总是被重新命名,因为模型需要TLC的新名称来检查其输出. 2个 小写单词或TLA+模块名保留其名称. 3个 所有其他识别符都被重新命名. 这一规则避免了对45个描述的破坏.

blocks.en: Identifier kinds. We sort the identifiers of the reference specifications of the 111 tasks into three categories, 1 domain words, 2 TLA + conventions such as Init and TypeOK and 3 abbreviations or single letter identifiers such as hr (see Appendix C ). Table C.1 shows that a third of the 1,788 identifiers that our CIR test modifies are domain words. The model never sees the reference specification and reads only its English description. Renaming changes the identifiers that this description mentions by name and leaves the rest of the text as it is, so ordinary words such as barrier or process remain (illustrated in Figure 1 ). Of the domain identifiers whose words the original description uses, 199/219 (91%) keep those words after CIR.
blocks.zh: 辨相之类. 我们把111项任务的参考规格识别符分为三类,一是域名,二是TLA+常规,如Init和TypeOK等;三是缩写或单字母识别符,如hr(见附录C. 表C.1显示,我们CIR测试修改的1,788个标识符中有三分之一是域名. 该模型从未看到参考规格,只读取其英文说明. Renaming修改了这个描述所提及名称的标识符,并留下了其他文本的原样,因此"屏障"或"过程"等普通的单词仍然保留(在图一中被擦出). 在原描述使用的词所使用域标识符中,199,219(91%)保留了CIR后这些词.

blocks.en: Hidden required names. The configuration file of a task names 1 the constants that TLC assigns values to, 2 the invariants and properties that TLC checks and 3 the constraints that limit the states TLC explores. An output is checked with this file, so it must define every identifier the file names. We call a listed identifier hidden if the description given to the model never mentions it by name. In the Barrier task, the configuration checks TypeOK and BarrierProperty , and the description mentions neither of these two names (illustrated in Figure 1 ). After renaming, the configuration asks for Octvcq and Bvwcdylhaazalut , so a correct output fails whether or not the model has seen the specification in training. We exclude Init , Next and Spec , because the prompt asks for them by name and the name-based grade accepts them under any name (see Appendix H ). In 78/111 tasks, the configuration file lists at least one hidden name, so a correct output must define that exact name to pass TLC, and 29 of these tasks list five or more. The 333 hidden names are 115 constants, 113 invariants, 87 properties and 18 constraints. With the original description, a model can still guess some hidden names without recall, because 77 follow TLA + conventions such as TypeOK . After renaming, every hidden name is a random string that no description, TLA + convention or published file contains. Renaming therefore changes two parts of a task, 1 the description, which loses the author’s identifiers but keeps most of its domain words, and 2 the configuration file, which requires exact names.
blocks.zh: 隐藏需要的名字 。 一个任务名的配置文件 1, TLC 分配给值的常数, 2, TLC 检查的不变量和属性, 以及限制状态 TLC 探索的3个限制. 使用此文件检查一个输出, 因此它必须定义文件名的每个标识符 。 如果给模型的描述从未提到它的名字,我们就叫一个隐藏的列表标识符。 在 " 障碍 " 任务中,配置检查TypeOK和 " 障碍财产 " ,说明中均未提及这两个名称(见图一)。 重命名后,配置要求Octvcq和Bvwcdylhaazalut ,因此一个正确的输出失败,无论模型是否在训练中看到规格. 我们排除了Init, Next and Spec, 因为即时要求他们的名字, 在78/111任务中,配置文件列出至少一个隐藏名称,因此正确的输出必须定义通过TLC的确切名称,其中29个任务列出5个或更多. 333个隐名有115个常数,113个不定数,87个属性和18个约束. 有了最初的描述,一个模型仍然可以猜测出一些隐藏的名字而无需回忆,因为有77个遵循了TypeOK等TLA + 常规. 重命名后,每个被隐藏的名字都是没有描述的随机字符串,TLA + Convention或已发布文件包含. 因此再命名修改了任务的两个部分,一个是描述,它失去了作者的标识符但保留了大部分域名;另一个是配置文件,它需要准确的名字.

blocks.en: Grading.
blocks.zh: 渐入.

blocks.en: Parsing. A module passes parsing in our grading only if SANY exits with code 0 and reports no error. However, SANY can complete parsing with an exit code of 0 even for semantic errors such as an undefined operator.
blocks.zh: 解说. 一个模块通过我们的分级 只有当SANY退出 代码0 并报告没有出错。 然而,SANY可以用一个0的退出代码来完成解析,甚至对于一个未定义的运算符等语义错误也是如此.

blocks.en: Name-based grade. This grade follows TLA + -Bench. An output is correct if it parses and passes TLC with the configuration file of its task, and a TLC run over 300 seconds counts as a failure. For a renamed task, each name in the configuration file is replaced by its new name from the renamed specification and description (see Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 以名为分. 这个等级跟随TLA + - Bench. 一个输出如果用任务配置文件来解析并传递 TLC 是正确的,一个 TLC 运行超过 300 秒算作失败 。 对于被重新命名的任务,配置文件中的每个名称被从被重新命名的规格和描述中取出的新名称所取代(见附录H.

blocks.en: Behavior-based grade. This grade compares the behaviors of an output G G with those of the reference R R and does not require the names of the configuration file. It searches for a one-to-one mapping from the variables and constants of R R to those of G G , with identical names first and then up to 60 permutations. Under a mapping, the forward check runs G G and checks the specification formula of R R and the invariants and properties of its configuration, with the definitions of R R , so it passes when every behavior of G G is a behavior of R R and satisfies the properties of R R . The reverse check runs R R and checks the safety formula 𝐼𝑛𝑖𝑡 ∧ □ ​ [ 𝑁𝑒𝑥𝑡 ] v \mathit{Init}\land\Box[\mathit{Next}]_{v} of G G under the inverse mapping, so an output that allows too few behaviors, such as one that never moves, fails. G G is correct when both checks pass under one mapping (see Appendix H ). Variables whose string values act as control labels, such as the pc of a PlusCal translation, get extra handling (see Appendix I ). Each condition is graded against its own reference specification, so the renamed condition uses the renamed specification, its renamed imported modules and the renamed configuration.
blocks.zh: 行为分等. 这个分级将输出出G G的行为与参考出R R的行为进行比较,不需要配置文件的名称. 它从 R 的变量和常数到 G G 的变量和常数中搜索到一对一的映射,其名称首先相同,然后最多60个外观. 在一幅映射下,前向检查运行了G,并检查了R R的规格公式及其配置的不常数和属性,以及R R 的定义,因此当G的每一个行为都是R R 的行为并满足了R R 的属性时,它就会通过. 反向检查运行 R 并检查 G 在反向映射下的安全公式 Init □ □ [Next] v\ mathit{ Init}\land\Box [\mathit{Next}}}\\\\v} G ,所以输出允许太少数的行为,如永不移动的行为,失败了. 在两次检查都通过一次绘图时,GG是正确的(见附录H)。 其字符串值起到控制标签作用的变量,如PlusCal翻译的pc,会得到额外的处理(见附录一. 每个条件都根据自己的参考规格进行分级,所以被重新命名的条件使用被重新命名的规格,被重新命名的被导入模块和被重新命名的配置.

blocks.en: Analysis and Metrics.
blocks.zh: 分析和计量。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report three metrics for each sample. 1 Parse , the output passes SANY with no syntax or semantic error. 2 Correct, name-based , the output parses and passes TLC under the configuration of its condition. 3 Correct, behavior-based , the output passes both refinement checks against the reference. We also report text similarity to the reference (see Appendix V ). The unit of analysis is the task. For each task and condition, the pass rate is the fraction of the five samples that pass, which estimates pass@1 Chen et al. (2021) . We report the mean difference between two conditions with a 95% confidence interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of tasks. We also report a two-sided sign test over the tasks whose pass rates differ. For the two renamings, we test equivalence with two one-sided tests at a margin of 5 points. Equivalence holds when the 90% bootstrap interval of the difference lies inside the margin.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告每个样本的三个指标。 1 解析,输出通过 SANY 没有语法或语义错误. 2 正确,以名称为基础,输出在条件配置下解析并传递 TLC 。 3 正确,基于行为,产出通过两个 完善检查与参考。 我们还报告案文与提及内容相似(见附录五)。 分析的单位就是任务. 对于每个任务和条件,通过率是通过5个样本的分数,估计通过@1 陈等 (2021). 我们报告两个条件之间的平均差别, 95%的置信间隔 与10 000个靴子夹重装任务。 我们还报告说,对通过率不同的任务进行了双面标志测试。 对于两个更名,我们测试等同两个单侧测试,相差5分. 当差值的90%的靴子间隔位于边以内时,等同性就维持住.

blocks.en: Experiment 1: Name-Based Grading. This experiment measures how renaming changes the correctness of frontier models under the grading that TLA + -Bench uses, and which tasks lose correctness.
blocks.zh: 实验一:取名分级. 这一实验测量了重新命名如何改变TLA + - Bench 使用的分级下前沿模型的正确性,以及哪些任务失去正确性.

blocks.en: Models and prompting. Renaming can only lower a score if the model writes some correct specifications for the original tasks. On TLA + -Bench, open-weight models pass TLC on at most 1% of system specifications and Claude Opus 4.5 passes on 16% Bisharat et al. (2026b) , so we study Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5. Both models receive the same prompt and write five independent samples per task and condition, and Experiment 3 grades the same outputs a second time. The prompt asks for a complete TLA + module with Init , Next , Spec and the safety, liveness and fairness conditions of the description (see Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 模型和激励。 雷纳明只有在模型为原始任务写出一些正确的规格时才能降低分数. 在TLA + - Bench上,开量模型在最多1%的系统规格上通过TLC,克洛德·奥普斯 4.5通过比沙拉特等16%(2026年b),因此我们研究克洛德·奥普斯 4.8和GPT-5. 两个模型都收到同样的即时并写出每个任务和条件的5个独立样本,实验3级再次输出相同. 该提示要求有一个完整的TLA+模块,包含Init, Next, Spec以及描述的安全性,活性和公平性条件(见附录A.).

blocks.en: Controls. Three controls test other explanations of a decrease. 1 We split the results by whether a task hides a required name (illustrated in Figure 1 ), because a hidden name fails a correct output in the renamed condition. 2 Random names may lower correctness because they carry no meaning, so a third condition replaces each identifier with a meaningful name that Opus 4.8 proposes, re-verified with SANY and TLC in the same way, which gives 77 valid tasks (see Appendix R ). 3 A file continuation test shows each model the first 40% of a published file with its repository and path and asks it to continue the file, and we compare the longest token run shared with the real file against the same run for the renamed copy, which no model can have seen (see Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 控制系统 三个控制测试了其他关于减少的解释。 1个 我们把结果分为一个任务是否隐藏一个需要的名称(在图1中被忽略),因为隐藏的名称在被重新命名的条件中失败了正确的输出. 2 随机名称可能因为没有意义而降低正确性,因此第三个条件用奥普斯4.8提议有意义的名称来取代每个标识符,以同样的方式与SANY和TLC重新验证,这给出了77个有效任务(见附录R. 3个 一个文件延续测试显示每个模型的发布文件的前40%有其寄存器和路径,并要求它继续文件,我们比较了共享的最长的符号运行与真实文件的运行,与重命名的复制的相同运行,没有模型能看到(见附录L.).

blocks.en: Experiment 2: Controlled Exposure. Experiment 1 cannot tell whether a model saw a task, because the training data of Opus 4.8 and GPT-5 is unknown. The pretraining data of open models such as Qwen and Gemma is not fully known either, so this experiment adds exposure that we control. It fine-tunes each model on half of the tasks and compares the renaming decrease on seen and unseen tasks.
blocks.zh: 实验 2:受控接触. 实验1无法判断一个模型是否看到任务,因为Opus 4.8和GPT-5的训练数据是未知的. Quen和Gemma等开放模型的预训数据也并不完全为人所知,因此这个实验增加了我们控制的曝光. 它微调了每个模型的一半任务,并比较了所见和所不见任务的更名减少。

blocks.en: Fine-tuned models. We split the 111 tasks at random with seed 20260926 into halves, A (55 tasks) and B (56 tasks). Both training sets contain the 292 model-checked TLA + -Bench tasks outside the test set. We fine-tune one copy of Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct on these 292 tasks and the 55 of half A, and a second copy on the 292 and the 56 of half B, and we shuffle each training set with a fixed seed. Each training pair consists of a declarative description and its reference specification. Every test task is thus seen by one model and unseen by the other. We call this task-pair exposure since the model sees each specification together with its test description. Both LLMs are fine-tuned with the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method Hu et al. (2022) and train for three epochs over their respective datasets, so each specification is seen three times in training (see Appendix E for the training settings). We test both models on the 110 tasks with a configuration in both conditions. We repeat the experiment with a second model family, Gemma 4 31B Gemma Team, Google DeepMind (2026) , fine-tuned on the same halves with the same training settings (see Appendix F ). Each model generates five samples per task and condition with temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.95 and at most 1,024 new tokens per sample.
blocks.zh: 精细的模型。 我们随机将111项任务与20260926种子分成了一半,A(55项任务)和B(56项任务). 两种训练集都包含292个模型检查的TLA +-测试集外的Bench任务. 微调出一出关于这292项任务的"Quen2.5-Coder-14B-指令"和"半A"的"55"的"Quen2.5-Coder-14B-指令";第二出关于"292"和"半B"的"56"的"后"的"后",用固定的种子来洗涤每套训练. 每对培训由申报说明及其参考说明组成。 因此,每个试验任务都由一个模型来看待,另一个模型却看不见。 我们称之为这种任务背面接触,因为模型看到每个规格及其试验说明。 两种LLMS都与低RANK适应(LORA)方法Hu等人(2022年)进行了微调并在各自数据集上为三个时代进行训练,因此每个规格在训练中三次被看到(培训环境见附录E). 我们在110项任务上测试两种型号,在两种条件下都有一个配置. 我们用第二个模型家族Gemma 4 31B Gemma Team,Google DeepMind(2026年)进行实验,用相同的训练环境对同一部分进行了微调(见附录F. 每个模型每个任务和条件产生5个样本,温度为0.7,最高 -- -- 第0.95页,每个样本最多产生1,024个新令牌。

blocks.en: Randomized exposure. Crossing the two models with the two conditions gives four cells per task. From these cells we measure 1 the exposure effect, the gain from training on a task, 2 how much renaming reduces that gain and 3 the renaming cost on unseen tasks.
blocks.zh: 随机相出. 与两个条件相交叉的两个模型,每个任务都给出了四个单元格. 从这些细胞中,我们测量了 1 暴露效应, 从任务培训中获得的收益, 2 重命名会减少这个收益, 和 3 重命名的成本 在看不见的任务。

blocks.en: Controls. Random names have more tokens, so renamed outputs more often hit the 1,024-token limit, and we repeat the analysis on the tasks with no truncated output (see Appendix N ). A second pair of models sees each half of the test set as the raw .tla file alone (see Appendix O ).
blocks.zh: 控制系统 随机名有较多的符号,因此更重命名的输出会更经常地打出1,024个托肯的极限,我们重复对没有截断输出的任务的分析(见附录N.). 第二对模型将每半个测试集单独视为生的.tla文件(见附录O.).

blocks.en: Log-likelihood. We also measure how likely each model finds the reference specification, given its description. This is the mean token log-likelihood, the average log-probability that the model assigns to each token of the reference, and a higher value means that the model expects that exact text more. The measure carries information even when few outputs pass TLC. We score the first 2,048 tokens of description and reference together, the length limit used in training. A gain in likelihood after exposure could come from the original names alone, so we also report the mean over the tokens that do not overlap a renamed identifier, which hold the keywords, operators and structure.
blocks.zh: 逻辑相通. 我们还衡量每个模型根据其描述找到参考规格的可能性。 这是平均符号日志的相似性,模型给每个参考符号分配的平均日志概率,更高的值意味着模型对准确文本的期望会更高. 即使没有多少产出通过TLC,该措施也带有信息。 我们得到了前2 048个描述和参考符号, 训练中使用的长度限制。 曝光后可能带来的收益可能仅来自原始名称,因此我们也报告不与重新命名的标识符相重叠的符号上的平均值,这些标识符持有关键词、操作符和结构。

blocks.en: Analysis. The exposure effect in each condition is the mean over tasks of the pass rate of the model that saw the task minus the pass rate of the model that did not. The change in the exposure effect under renaming is the difference in differences (DiD) DiD = 1 n ​ ∑ s [ ( c s − r s ) seen − ( c s − r s ) unseen ] , \mathrm{DiD}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{s}\Big[(c_{s}-r_{s})_{\text{seen}}-(c_{s}-r_{s})_{\text{unseen}}\Big], where c s c_{s} and r s r_{s} are the pass rates (or mean log-likelihoods) of task s s in the original and renamed conditions, respectively. The first term uses the model that saw s s and the second uses the model that did not. A positive DiD means that renaming costs more on seen tasks. The renaming cost on unseen tasks is 1 n ​ ∑ s ( c s − r s ) unseen \frac{1}{n}\sum_{s}(c_{s}-r_{s})_{\text{unseen}} , and memory plays no part in it.

blocks.en: Experiment 3: Behavior-Based Grading. Experiment 1 grades outputs by name, so a correct output fails whenever it misses a hidden name. This experiment grades the same outputs of Opus 4.8 and GPT-5 again by behavior and compares the decrease under both grades on the same tasks. A decrease that remains under the behavior-based grade cannot come from hidden names.
blocks.zh: 实验3:以行为为主的分级. 实验 1 级的输出按名称排列,所以每当错过隐藏名称时,正确的输出都会失败. 这一实验再次通过行为对Opus 4.8和GPT-5的相同输出进行分级,并比较了两个分级在相同任务下的下降. 低于基于行为等级的下降不能来自隐藏名称。

blocks.en: Grader validation. As positive controls, the grade should accept each reference against itself, each renamed reference with its renamed imported modules and a copy of each reference with renamed operators that still passes SANY and TLC. As negative controls, it should reject mutants, which change one number, comparison, initial value, guard or disjunct of a reference, and we keep a mutant only if TLC reports a different number of reachable states (see Appendix J ). The grade covers the 90/111 tasks whose reference passes against itself, and both grades are compared on these tasks.
blocks.zh: 年级鉴定. 作为正控,分级应接受每个参照本身,每个被更名的参照与其被更名的进口模块,以及每个被更名的运算符的副本,这些运算符仍然通过SANY和TLC. 作为负控,它应该拒绝变种人,因为变种人会改变一个数字,比较,初始值,守卫或断开一个参考物,我们只有在TLC报告不同数量的可达状态时才会保留变种人(见附录J. 该职等涵盖90/111项参照工作,这两个职等都与这些任务进行比较。

blocks.en: Disagreements. We read the outputs on which the two grades disagree and sort them by cause. As an upper bound on errors of our grader, we also recompute the decrease with every output that passes only the name-based grade counted as correct (see Appendix P for the cases).
blocks.zh: 诸相违相. 我们读了两个年级有分歧的产出,并按原因分类。 作为我们分级员错误的上限,我们还根据每个只通过按名计的分级的输出来重新计算减少数(案例见附录P).

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Experiment 1: Name-Based Grading. Opus 4.8. Opus 4.8 is correct on 28.3% of samples with the original descriptions and on 18.2% with the renamed ones ( Table 1 ), a mean decrease per task of 10.1 points (95% CI 5.0 to 15.7), with 18 tasks that now fail and two that now pass (sign test p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 ). The parse rate stays near 81% in both conditions. In the original condition it would be 93.3% if outputs that SANY accepts with exit code 0 despite a semantic error counted as parsed.
blocks.zh: 实验一:取名分级. opus 4.8 (英语). 28.3%的样本(原始说明)和18.2%的样本(表1)正确无误,每个任务平均减少10.1分(95%CI 5.0至15.7),其中18个任务现在失败,两个任务现在通过(签名测试p=0.0004 p=0.0004)。 在这两种条件下,剖析率都保持在81%左右。 在原始条件下,如果SANY接受的输出以退出代码0表示,尽管一个语义错误算作解析,则为93.3%.

blocks.en: Table 1: Frontier models on the test set, in percent. Meaningful names use the 77 tasks with a valid meaningful renaming, and the behavior-based rows use the 90 that the grade covers.
blocks.zh: 表1:测试组的前沿模型,百分比。 有意义的名称使用77个任务,并用有效的有意义的更名,而以行为为基础的行使用等级所覆盖的90.

blocks.en: Hidden names. On the 78 tasks with a hidden required name, correctness is 11.3% with the original descriptions and 0.0% with the renamed ones, so all 14 tasks that passed now fail (see Figure S.1 ). On the 33 tasks whose descriptions state every required name, correctness is 68.5% and 61.2%, a decrease of 7.3 points (95% CI − 2.4 -2.4 to 18.2), with four tasks that now fail and two that now pass.
blocks.zh: 隐藏的名字。 在78项有隐藏需要的名称的任务上,正确性为11.3%与原始描述,而0.0 %与被重新命名的描述,因此过去的所有14项任务现在都失败了(见图S.1. 在33项任务中,说明每个所需名称的正确度分别为68.5%和61.2%,减少了7.3分(95%的CI - 2.4 - 2.4到18.2),其中四项任务现已失败,两项任务现已通过。

blocks.en: Meaningful names. Under the name-based grade, meaningful and random names score the same in correctness within a margin of 5 points (see Appendix R ).
blocks.zh: 有意义的名字。 在以名称为基础的等级下,有意义的和随机的名称在5分的比分内在正确度上得分相同(见附录R.

blocks.en: GPT-5. GPT-5 is correct on 9.2% of samples with the original descriptions and 7.0% with the renamed ones, a decrease of 2.2 points (95% CI − 0.4 -0.4 to 4.7), and on the 78 tasks with a hidden name it falls from 2.3% to 0.0%.
blocks.zh: GPT-5. GPT-5对9.2%的样本有原始描述,7.0%的样本有重新命名的样本是正确的,降低了2.2分(95%的CI−0.4-0.4至4.7分),对78项有隐藏名称的任务,它从2.3%下降到了0.0%.

blocks.en: File continuation. How much of a published file a model can continue does not predict which tasks lose correctness under renaming (see Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 文件续作. 一个模型能够持续多久的已公布文件并不能预测哪些任务在重命名下失去正确性(见附录L.

blocks.en: What Experiment 1 shows. Renaming lowers the correctness of Opus 4.8 by about a third, which a CIR test reads as memorization. The decrease sits on the 78 tasks with hidden names, where the renamed configuration asks for random names that no model can know, and the 33 tasks that state every name lose 7.3 points with an interval that includes 0. Meaningful names and file continuation do not explain the decrease. Under the grading of TLA + -Bench, a renaming decrease thus measures the grade as well as the model, and Experiment 3 tests how much.
blocks.zh: 实验一显示的 雷纳明将"Opus 4.8"的正确性降低约三分之一,CIR测试读作"记忆". 减少的原因在于78项有隐藏名称的任务,重新命名的配置要求随机命名,而没有模型能够知道这些名称,33项说明每个名称都损失了7.3分,间隔包括: 0. 有意义的名字和文件续作并不能说明减少的原因。 在TLA + - Bench的分级下,重新命名的分数会测量等级和模型,实验3测试了多少分.

blocks.en: Experiment 2: Controlled Exposure. Qwen. Under the behavior-based grade, training on a task raises the correctness of Qwen by 7.6 points (95% CI 3.8 to 12.0) with the original descriptions and by 4.2 points (95% CI 1.1 to 7.8) with the renamed ones ( Table 2 ; see also Figure T.1 ). Renaming lowers correctness by 4.9 points (95% CI 2.0 to 8.4) on unseen tasks. The DiD is 3.3 points (95% CI − 0.2 -0.2 to 7.3), and 3.5 points (95% CI 0.4 to 6.9) under the name-based grade on 110 tasks.
blocks.zh: 实验 2:受控接触. 腾讯. 在基于行为的等级下,一项任务的培训使Quen的正确性在原描述下提高了7.6分(95% CI 3.8至12.0分),在被重新命名的分中提高了4.2分(95% CI 1.1至7.8分)(表2;又见图T.1)。 在隐形任务上,重命名将正确度降低4.9分(95% CI 2.0至8.4分). DiD为3.3分(95% CI − 0.2-0.2至7.3),以110个任务为取名分的3.5分(95% CI 0.4至6.9).

blocks.en: Table 2: Effects of task-pair exposure for two model families with 95% CIs, in percentage points for correctness and in mean token log-likelihood for likelihood. Unseen cost is original minus renamed on unseen tasks, and other uses only tokens outside renamed identifiers.
blocks.zh: 表2:对95%CI的2个模范家庭而言,任务包接触的影响,正确度的百分点和概率的平价对比。 不明成本在被忽略的任务上是原始的去除被重新命名的,而其他用途仅在被重新命名的标识器之外使用符号.

blocks.en: Likelihood. For 108/110 tasks, the Qwen model trained on a task finds its reference specification more likely than the other model. Renaming lowers this exposure effect from 0.34 to 0.18, a DiD of 0.16 (95% CI 0.13 to 0.19) that is positive for 110/110 tasks. On the tokens outside the renamed identifiers, the DiD is 0.07 (95% CI 0.06 to 0.09) and positive for 101/110 tasks.
blocks.zh: 可能吗? 对于108/110任务,接受过一项任务培训的Quen模型发现其参考规格比其他模型更可能. 重新命名将这种接触效应从0.34降至0.18, 其二维值为0.16 (95% CI 0.13至0.19),这对110/110任务是积极的。 在被重新命名的识别器以外的标志上,DiD是0.07(95% CI 0.06至0.09),对101/110任务是正数.

blocks.en: Gemma 4. Gemma 4 31B shows an exposure effect of 8.0 points (95% CI 3.6 to 12.9) and a likelihood DiD of 0.15 (95% CI 0.12 to 0.18), with a higher likelihood for the seen model on 109/110 tasks. Its renaming cost on unseen tasks is 1.3 points (95% CI − 2.0 -2.0 to 4.9) under the behavior-based grade and 4.2 points (95% CI 0.4 to 8.5) under the name-based grade (see Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 盖玛 4. Gemma 4 31B显示接触效应为8.0分(95% CI 3.6至12.9分)和概率为0.15分(95% CI 0.12至0.18分),在109/110任务上看到模型的可能性较高。 它在隐形任务上的更名成本为:行为等级下1.3分(95% CI − 2.0 - 2.0到 4.9分)和行为等级下4.2分(95% CI 0.4到 8.5分) (见附录F.).

blocks.en: Controls. On the 43/90 tasks with no truncated output, the renaming cost on unseen tasks is 9.8 points (95% CI 3.7 to 16.3; see Appendix N ). Models fine-tuned on the raw TLA + files show no effect on correctness, and their likelihood DiD is 0.08 (95% CI 0.07 to 0.10; see Appendix O ).
blocks.zh: 控制系统 关于没有截断输出的43/90任务,对隐形任务的重命名成本为9.8分(95% CI 3.7至16.3;见附录N )。 在原始的TLA + 文件上进行微调的模型显示对正确性没有影响,其概率为 0.08 (95% CI 0.07至 0.10;见附录 O.).

blocks.en: What Experiment 2 shows. With exposure known, the two parts of a decrease separate. Training leaves a memory of the seen tasks, and renaming removes about half of the likelihood gain in both families, including on keywords and structure that renaming leaves unchanged. On correctness, the DiD interval includes 0 under the behavior-based grade in both families, so the part of a correctness decrease that comes from memory is too small to measure on 90 tasks. Renaming also lowers correctness on tasks a model never saw, by 4.9 points for Qwen, where memory plays no part. A renaming decrease can therefore appear without memorization, and its size depends on the model.
blocks.zh: 2号实验显示的 随着接触的已知,减少的两个部分是分开的。 训练留下了对所见任务的记忆,而更名消除了两个家族约一半的可能性收益,包括重名不变的关键词和结构. 关于正确性,DiD间隔包含两个家族中基于行为分级下的0,因此来自内存的正确性下降部分太小,无法衡量90个任务. Renaming还降低了一个模型从未见过的任务的正确性,对Qwen来说是4.9分,因为记忆没有作用. 因此,重新命名的减少可以出现而不记起,其大小取决于模型.

blocks.en: Experiment 3: Behavior-Based Grading. Grader validation. The grader accepts all 90 renamed references and all 56 valid operator-renamed copies, and rejects all 105 mutants with altered behavior (see Table J.1 ).
blocks.zh: 实验3:以行为为主的分级. 年级鉴定. 该分级器接受所有90个更名的参考文献和所有56个有效的操作员更名副本,并拒绝所有105个行为有改变的变种人(见表J.1)。

blocks.en: Opus 4.8. On the 90 tasks that both grades cover (see Figure U.1 ), Opus 4.8 is correct on 31.8% of samples with the original descriptions and on 21.3% with the renamed ones under the name-based grade, a decrease of 10.4 points (95% CI 4.7 to 16.9). Under the behavior-based grade, it is correct on 38.4% and 35.3%, a decrease of 3.1 points (95% CI − 0.9 -0.9 to 7.3; see Appendix U ). In the Barrier task, all five renamed outputs fail the name-based grade on the hidden names and pass the behavior-based grade.
blocks.zh: opus 4.8 (英语). 在两个年级覆盖的90个任务(见图U.1)中,有31.8%的样本有原始描述,21.3%的样本有以名称为基础的级别,减少了10.4分(95%CI 4.7分为16.9分)。 在基于行为的等级下,38.4%和35.3%是正确的,下降了3.1分(95%的CI−0.9-0.9至7.3;见附录U)。 在"障碍"任务中,所有被重新命名的5个输出都会在隐藏名称上失败以名称为基础的分级,并通过以行为为基础的分级.

blocks.en: Disagreements. Most outputs that pass only the behavior-based grade miss a hidden name. Outputs that pass only the name-based grade behave differently from the reference or hit a limit of our grader, and the different ones pass because TLC checks each invariant with the output’s own definition, so even an output that defines TypeOK as TRUE passes that check (see Appendix P ). If every name-only pass counts as correct, the decrease is 5.1 points (95% CI 0.4 to 10.2) for Opus 4.8 and 0.4 points (95% CI − 3.1 -3.1 to 4.0) for GPT-5.
blocks.zh: 诸相违相. 大多数只通过基于行为等级的输出都错过了隐藏的名称. 仅通过基于名的分级的输出行为不同于引用,或者击中了我们的分级器的极限,而不同的分级则通过,因为TLC根据输出本身的定义检查了每个不变量,所以甚至一个将TypeOK定义为TRUE通过检查的输出(见附录P). 如果每个单名传球都算正确,则Opus 4.8和0.4分(95% CI − 3.1-3.1至4.0)的分数下降为5.1分(95% CI − 4.1至4.0分),GPT-5为0.4分.

blocks.en: GPT-5. On the same 90 tasks, the decrease of GPT-5 is 2.4 points under the name-based grade and 0.0 points (95% CI − 3.6 -3.6 to 3.3) under the behavior-based grade, with 10.9% in both conditions. Its 90% interval, − 2.9 -2.9 to 2.9, lies inside the 5-point margin, but at a base rate near 11% this margin is almost half of GPT-5’s correctness.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-09-25). GPT-5. 在同一90个任务上,GPT-5的降分在取名分下为2.4分,在取名分下为0.0分(95% CI−3.6-3.6到3.3),在行为分下为10.9%. 其90%的间隔 — 2.9 - 2.9 至 2.9 位于5 点比值之内,但以接近11%的基率计算,这一比值几乎是GPT-5正确度的一半.

blocks.en: What Experiment 3 shows. When the grade ignores names, the decrease of Opus 4.8 falls from 10.4 to 3.1 points and that of GPT-5 from 2.4 to 0.0 points, and for Opus 4.8 the 64 covered tasks with hidden names lose only 2.5 points (see Appendix U ). Most of the decrease in Experiment 1 thus came from the grade. The interval for Opus 4.8 still reaches 7.3 points, so a cost of new names of the size that Experiment 2 measures on unseen tasks is still possible for Opus 4.8.
blocks.zh: 3号实验显示的 当分数忽略取名时,Opus 4.8的分数从10.4分降到了3.1分,而GPT-5的分数从2.4分降到了0.0分,而对于Opus 4.8,有隐名的64个被覆盖的任务只损失了2.5分(见附录U.). 因此,实验1的减少大部分来自年级。 Opus 4.8的间隔仍然达到7.3分,因此奥普斯 4.8仍有可能使用实验2对隐形任务测量大小的新名称的成本.

blocks.en: Discussion. Implications for TLA + benchmarks. Experiments 1 and 3 show that a check with the reference configuration file grades both what a specification does and how it names identifiers, and in 78/111 of our tasks the description leaves out a required name. Listing every required name in the task separates the two, but it also tells the model which invariants and properties to write, which removes part of the task. The same check accepts outputs with weaker invariants (Experiment 3), and the SANY exit code overstates parsing (Experiment 1). Of four public TLA + benchmarks, only TLA + -Bench needs a name that the task does not state (see Table Q.1 ).
blocks.zh: 讨论。 对技术援助+基准的影响。 实验1和3显示,与参考配置文件进行核对时,既要说明一个规格做什么,又要说明它如何命名标识符,在78/111我们的任务中,说明中漏出一个规定的名称。 在任务中列出每一个需要的名称将两者分开,但它也讲述了哪些变化和属性可以写出,从而去除部分任务. 同样的检查接受偏差较小的输出(Experiment 3),而SANY的出站代码则超标了解析(Experiment 1). 在四种公开的TLA+基准中,只有TLA+-Bench需要一个任务没有说明的名称(见表Q.1.

blocks.en: Implications for benchmark builders. From these results, we suggest four practices for TLA + benchmarks, 1 grade by behavior against the reference’s own properties, 2 when grading depends on names, state every required name in the task or report tasks with hidden names separately, 3 count semantic errors as parse failures and 4 re-verify renamed copies with the model checker. The same may hold outside TLA + , because names carry meaning in code as well Le et al. (2025) , and unit tests and proof checkers also look up names that tasks may omit.
blocks.zh: 对基准制定者的影响。 从这些结果来看,我们建议TLA + 基准的四种做法,一种是针对参考物自身属性的行为分级,两种是取决于名称的分级,在任务中说明每个需要的名称或单独报告隐藏名称的任务,3个语义错误作为解析失败,4个用模型检查器重新验证重命名的拷贝. 也可能在TLA + 之外持有,因为名字在代码中也有意义,而Le et al. (2025),单位测试和校验器也会查找任务可能忽略的名字.

blocks.en: Implications for contamination studies. Experiment 2 shows that, under a grade that ignores names, a decrease after renaming can still come from two sources, memory of the original task and the cost of working with new names, and that known exposure separates them. Memory shows in the models we fine-tuned, since renaming removed about half of the gain from training in how likely the model finds the reference. The cost of new names shows on tasks a model never saw, since memory plays no part there, and under the behavior-based grade it was 4.9 points for Qwen and 1.3 points for Gemma (95% CI − 2.0 -2.0 to 4.9). On a model whose training data is unknown, a single decrease adds these two sources together and cannot separate them. For Opus 4.8 and GPT-5, most of the decrease comes from grading, and the interval of the decrease under the behavior-based grade includes 0 but leaves room for a name cost of several points. Contamination studies could add a model with known exposure and report the decrease separately for seen and unseen items.
blocks.zh: 对污染研究的影响。 实验2显示,在忽略名字的分级下,再命名后的减少仍然可以来自两个方面,即原任务记忆和用新名字工作的成本,而已知的曝光将它们分开. 记忆显示在我们微调过的模型中,因为重命名取消了大约一半的培训收益,即模型找到参考的可能性. 新名称的成本显示在模型从未见过的任务上,因为内存在那里没有作用,在基于行为分级下,Quen为4.9分,Gemma为1.3分(95% CI − 2.0 - 2.0到 4.9分). 在一个培训数据不详的模型上,单次减少就增加了这两个来源,无法将它们分开。 对Opus 4.8和GPT-5来说,降分多出自分级,以行为为基础的分级下降分间隔包括0分,但留下了数分名费的空间. 污染研究可增加一个已知暴露的模型,并就可见和看不见的物品分别报告减少情况。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We renamed every author-defined identifier in 111 model-checked TLA + specifications and confirmed with SANY and TLC that each renamed benchmark task keeps the behaviors of the original task. Under the grading of TLA + -Bench, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28.3% to 18.2%, mostly because of configuration names that the description never states. Graded by behavior, the decrease is 3.1 points for Opus 4.8 (95% CI − 0.9 -0.9 to 7.3) and 0.0 points for GPT-5 (95% CI − 3.6 -3.6 to 3.3). In the LLMs we fine-tuned, training made the reference specification more likely to the model, and renaming removed about half of that gain. On tasks a model never saw, renaming lowered correctness by 4.9 points for Qwen and 1.3 points for Gemma. A decrease after renaming therefore mixes memorization with grading by name and with the cost of new names, so it cannot show memorization by itself.
blocks.zh: 我们把111个模型检查过的TLA+规格中每个作者定义的标识符重新命名,并与SANY和TLC确认,每个被重新命名的基准任务都保留了原始任务的行为. 在TLA +- Bench的分级下,更名将克洛德·奥普斯4.8的正确性从28.3%降低到18.2%,这主要是因为描述从未说明过的配置名. 按行为分级,Opus 4.8分(95% CI−0.9-0.9至7.3分)和GPT-5分(95% CI−3.6至3.3分)的分数下降为3.1分. 在我们微调的LLMs中,培训使得参考规格更容易被模型所使用,并重新命名取消了大约一半的收益. 在任务上,一个模型从未见过,重新命名将Quen的正确度降低了4.9分,Gemma的正确度降低了1.3分。 因此,重新命名后减少的金额与按名称分级和新名称的成本相混合,因此本身无法显示记忆.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Internal validity. The descriptions shape what a model writes, and TLA + -Bench writes them with an LLM. Every comparison in our experiments is paired, because the original and renamed versions of a task share one description and differ only in the renamed identifiers, so the quality of a description affects both conditions equally and does not change the decrease. The renaming rule keeps 91% of the domain words of a description, so the renamed task asks for the same system. The rule also keeps the names of known algorithms such as Paxos, which a model could use to recall a known specification. Tasks with such a name are harder for both frontier models and lose no more correctness under renaming than the other tasks (see Appendix M ), so this risk is small, and a direct test that asks for a specification from the algorithm name alone needs further study. Claude Opus 4.8 proposed the meaningful names and is also tested on them, so these names may suit it. In the exposure experiment, both models of a family share the same 292 training tasks with original names, so even unseen tasks follow naming conventions that the models learned.
blocks.zh: 内部有效性。 描述塑造了模型写作的形状,TLA + - Bench用LLM写作. 我们实验中的每一个比较都是对齐的,因为一个任务的原版和被更名的版本共享一个描述,只在被更名的识别符上存在差异,因此一个描述的质量平等地影响了两个条件,并没有改变下降. 更名规则保留了描述中91%的域名,因此被更名的任务要求相同的系统. 该规则还保留了Paxos等已知算法的名称,一个模型可以用来回忆已知的规格. 具有这种名称的任务对于两个边疆模型来说都比较困难,在更名下不会失去比其他任务(见附录M)更准确的分量,因此这种风险很小,仅要求从算法名称中作出说明的直接测试需要进一步研究. 克洛德·奥普斯 4.8提出了有意义的名字,并对他们进行了测试,因此这些名字可能适合它. 在曝光实验中,两个家族的模型都有着相同的292个具有原名的训练任务,因此即使隐蔽的任务也遵循了模型学到的命名惯例.

blocks.en: Construct validity. We measure three constructs. 1 Correctness is passing TLC on the finite instance that the configuration bounds, so an output that passes may still be wrong for larger parameters. The behavior-based grade requires as many variables and constants as the reference and searches at most 60 variable mappings, so an output that splits a variable or derives a declared constant fails even when its behaviors match. Its reverse check tests only the output’s safety formula, so it accepts extra fairness conditions. 2 Memorization is the exposure effect of LoRA fine-tuning on each task three times with its test description. Contamination through public files exposes a model to the file alone, and our specification-only arm, which trains this way, stays too low on correctness to show an effect (see Table O.1 ). LoRA updates only small low-rank weights, so it may understate the memory that pretraining leaves. 3 The cost of new names is the decrease on unseen tasks. Random names also lengthen the token sequence, which the truncation analysis controls (see Appendix N ), and CIR keeps the structure of a specification, so a model can still use a recalled structure.

blocks.en: External validity. All tasks come from one benchmark, TLA + -Bench, and the 111 reference specifications are mostly single-module. The exposure experiment uses two open model families, and the cost of new names differs between them, 4.9 points for Qwen and 1.3 points for Gemma, so its size depends on the model and may differ for frontier models.
blocks.zh: 外证相通. 所有任务都来自一个基准TLA +- Bench,111参考规格大多为单模. 曝光实验采用两个开放的模型家族,新名字的成本在它们之间有所不同,Quen的4.9分和Gemma的1.3分,因此其大小取决于模型,对于前沿模型可能有所不同.

blocks.en: Statistical conclusion validity. The main threat is sample size, because public TLA + specifications are few and TLA + -Bench has only 146 model-checked system specifications. The behavior-based grade covers 90 tasks, the group with every required name stated has 33, and the pass rates of the exposure experiment lie between 7% and 23%, so a decrease of a few points falls inside the intervals, and the DiD on correctness includes 0 for both families. The likelihood measure does not depend on correct outputs and shows the exposure effect and its reduction under renaming clearly. We report several comparisons without a correction for multiple tests, and the bootstrap resamples tasks and misses the variation between training runs, since each exposure model is trained once with one split and one seed.

blocks.en: TLC checks two kinds of properties, 1 invariants, which must hold in every state the system reaches, and 2 temporal properties, which must hold over whole behaviors. For the clock, an invariant called TypeOK could state that hr is always a number from 1 to 12. A temporal property can be a safety property, such as that a process never leaves a barrier early, or a liveness property, such as that the clock eventually shows 12. A clock that stops ticking may never reach 12, so a liveness property needs a fairness condition in the specification formula, which states that the clock keeps ticking Lamport (2002) .
blocks.zh: TLC检查两种属性,一种是系统所达到的每个州必须持有的不变量,而两种是时间属性,必须持有整个行为. 对于时钟来说,一个叫TypeOK的无变体可以表示:hr总是从1到12的数字. 时间性财产可以是安全性财产,例如过程从不过早地留下障碍物,也可以是活地性财产,例如时钟最终显示为12. 停止计时的时钟可能永远达不到12分,因此活地财产需要在规格公式中有一个公平条件,该公式规定计时持续计时Lamport(2002).

blocks.en: Appendix I Control-Label Variables in the Behavior-Based Grade
blocks.zh: 附录一 基于行为等级的控制标签变量

blocks.en: Some variables have string values that act as control labels, as in the pc variable of a PlusCal translation. Their values depend on the label names, which the description does not fix. For a reference with such variables, the grader also tries 1-to-1 mappings between the string values of the two modules. If no mapping passes, it compares the two modules on their data variables. TLC writes the state graph of each module, the grader projects every state onto the data variables, and the two projected graphs must accept the same sequences of observable states. In one reference, the PlusCal translator names a step "Lbl_1" . An output that names the same step "start" passes under the mapping from "Lbl_1" to "start" .

blocks.en: Appendix J Validation of the Behavior-Based Grade
blocks.zh: 附录J 基于行为的级别验证

blocks.en: This experiment depends on the behavior-based grade, so we check that it accepts what it should and rejects what it should. We validate it on the 110 tasks that have a configuration. Of these, 8 stay in the test set for name-based grading, since they pass SANY and TLC after renaming and are valid tasks under benchmark practice, and we exclude them from behavior-based grading only. That grade needs 1 TLC results that repeat across runs, which the specifications that use random values do not give, and 2 system behavior to compare, which the test fixtures of the TLA + tools do not describe. This leaves 102 tasks eligible for behavior-based grading. The grader accepts 90/102 references against themselves, and the other 12 use constructs that it does not translate, so the behavior-based grade covers 90/111 tasks (see Table K.1 ). The remaining task has no TLC configuration, so every output for it fails the name-based grade in every condition and does not change any decrease. For positive controls, we grade each reference against itself, a copy of each reference with its operators renamed to random names of the same width, and each renamed reference together with the renamed modules it imports. An operator-renamed copy counts only if it passes SANY and TLC, so operators that the configuration overrides by name or that an INSTANCE substitutes by name keep their names. For negative controls, we mutate each reference. A mutation changes a numeric literal by 1, flips a comparison, replaces a string value in the initial state, or deletes a conjunct of an action, a guard of an action, or a disjunct of the next-state relation. We keep a mutant only if TLC reports a different number of distinct reachable states for it, counted on the data variables for references with control-label variables. Every kept mutant thus behaves differently from its reference, and a correct grader must reject it. This selection makes rejection the easy direction, because TLC already exhibits the difference on the tested instance and the controls include no restructured but behaviorally equivalent specifications beyond renamings, so the false-negative rate on outputs that differ structurally from the reference is known only from the disagreements inspected in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 这个实验取决于基于行为的等级,所以我们检查它是否接受它应该接受什么,拒绝它应该接受什么. 我们在110项有配置的任务中验证它。 其中,8个停留在基于名的分级的测试集中,因为它们在重命名后通过SANY和TLC,是基准实践中有效的任务,我们仅将其排除在基于行为分级之外. 该分级需要1个重复跨行的TLC结果,使用随机值的规格不给出这些结果,需要2个系统行为来比较,TLA+工具的测试定着没有对此进行描述. 这使得102个任务有资格进行基于行为的分级. 分级者接受针对自己的90/102引用,而其他12个用法则认为它不翻译,因此基于行为的分级涵盖了90/111任务(见表K.1. 所剩任务没有TLC配置,因此每个条件的每个输出都失败了以名为基础的等级,不会改变任何减少. 对于正控,我们对照自己对每个引用进行分级,每引用一个副本,其操作员被重新命名为相同宽度的随机名称,每个被重新命名的引用连同它所导入的被重新命名的模块. 一个操作员改名的复制件只有在通过SANY和TLC时才算数,因此操作员的配置会按名称覆盖,或者INSTANCE的代名词保留他们的名字. 对于负控,我们变换每个引用。 突变会以 1 来改变一个数字字形, 翻转比较, 在初始状态中替换一个字符串值, 或删除一个动作的组合, 动作的守护, 或邻态关系的断接. 只有当TLC报告不同数量的可达到状态时,我们才保留一个变异体,并依靠数据变量作为有控制标签变量的参考。 每一个被保存的变种人的行为都与其参考不同,正确的分级者必须拒绝. 由于TLC在测试实例上已经显示出差异, 并且控制中除了重命名之外, 没有经过重组但行为等同的规格, 因此, 与参考文献结构不同的产出的假负率只能从第4节所检查的分歧中得知。

blocks.en: Appendix L File Continuation
blocks.zh: 附录 L 文件继续

blocks.en: Setup. For each specification we show the model its first 40% of lines (at least 8 and at most 60), tell it the repository and path the file comes from and ask it to continue the file exactly. The repository and path help a model that saw the file in training recall it Golchin and Surdeanu (2024) . We remove comments and separator lines from the model’s output and from the rest of the real file, and we count the longest stretch of tokens that the two texts share word for word, so a long shared stretch suggests the model has seen the file. We run the same test on the renamed copy, which no model can have seen because it exists only in our study, so its shared stretches show how much matching comes from the common TLA + text alone.
blocks.zh: 设相. 对于每个规格,我们显示模型的前40%的行(至少8行,最多60行),告诉它寄存器和路径文件来自,并要求它准确地继续文件. 寄存器和路径帮助一个在训练中看到文件的模型召回了Golchin和Surdeanu(2024年). 我们从模型的输出和从其他真实文件中去掉评论和分隔线,我们计算出两个文本在文字上共享最长的符号长度,所以一个长期共享的长度表明模型已经看到了文件. 我们在被重新命名的拷贝上进行同样的测试,由于它只存在于我们的研究中,所以没有模型能够看见,因此其共享的拉伸显示,光是普通的TLA + 文本就会产生多少匹配.

blocks.en: Findings. Opus 4.8 continues 46/111 specifications with a run of at least 50 tokens identical to the real file, and 25 renamed copies, which exist nowhere online, also produce such a run, since TLA + modules share boilerplate. The 46 tasks whose file has a long run lose 8.7 points of correctness under renaming, and the other 65 lose 11.1 points (permutation p = 0.70 p=0.70 ). The run on the original minus the run on the renamed copy has a Spearman correlation of 0.07 with the decrease (permutation p = 0.48 p=0.48 ), and the 11 tasks above the 95th percentile of runs on renamed copies lose 0.0 points (permutation p = 0.25 p=0.25 ). The continuation test therefore does not predict which tasks lose correctness. GPT-5 continues 11 specifications with a run of at least 50 tokens.
blocks.zh: 发现 Opus 4.8延续了46/111规格,跑出至少50个与真实文件完全相同的令牌,25个重新命名的拷贝在网络上根本不存在,也会产生这样的跑出,因为TLA + 模块共享锅炉板. 其文件长期存续的46个任务在更名下损失了8.7分的正确性,其他65个则损失了11.1分(permutation p=0.70 p=0.70. 原版跑去减去被更名副本的跑去时,斯皮尔曼的关联度为0.07与下降(permutation p=0.48 p=0.48),在被更名副本上跑去的95%以上的11个任务会失去0.0分(permutation p=0.25 p=0.25). 因此,继续测试无法预测哪些任务会失去正确性。 GPT-5延续了11个规格,跑出至少50个令牌.

blocks.en: Appendix M Known Algorithm Names
blocks.zh: 附录M 已知 算法名称

blocks.en: Setup. The renamed descriptions keep the names of published algorithms, protocols and classic problems, such as Paxos, the Bakery algorithm, Euclid’s algorithm or the dining philosophers, and a model could use such a name to recall a known specification. We mark the tasks whose renamed description contains a name from a fixed list, which gives 37/111 tasks, and a broader list that adds problem words such as consensus, mutual exclusion and spanning tree gives 48/111. We compare the original correctness and the decrease after renaming between the marked tasks and the others, with a permutation test on the difference between the two mean decreases.
blocks.zh: 设相. 被更名的描述保留了公布的算法,协议和经典问题的名称,如Paxos,Bakey算法,Euclid的算法或餐会哲学家,一个模型可以使用这样的名称来回忆已知的规格. 我们标出其重新命名的描述中包含一个固定列表的名称的任务,该列表给出了37/111的任务,而一个更宽泛的列表中添加了诸如共识,相互排斥和横跨树等问题词语,则给出了48/111. 我们比较了标记任务和其他任务重命名后的原始正确性和减少,同时对两个正差的相差进行通缩测试.

blocks.en: Findings. Tasks with a known name are harder. Under the behavior-based grade, Opus 4.8 is correct on 13.8% of samples for the 32 covered tasks with a known name and on 52.1% for the other 58. The decrease after renaming is 1.2 points (95% CI − 5.6 -5.6 to 7.5) on tasks with a known name and 4.1 points (95% CI − 0.7 -0.7 to 10.0) on the others (permutation p = 0.59 p=0.59 ), and under the name-based grade it is 7.0 and 11.6 points ( p = 0.45 p=0.45 ). The broader list gives p = 0.54 p=0.54 and p = 0.60 p=0.60 , and GPT-5 shows no difference under either grade or list ( p ≥ 0.22 p\geq 0.22 ). A known name thus neither makes a task easier nor protects it from the decrease, so recall through such names does not explain our results. The marked tasks are also the more complex ones, so this comparison cannot rule out a small effect of the names.
blocks.zh: 发现 使用已知名称的任务更困难 。 在基于行为的等级下,13.8%的标本标本标本的Opus 4.8为有名的32个被覆盖任务的标本正确,其他58个标本的标本为52.1%正确. 改名后的降分为:已知名称任务1.2分(95% CI−5.6-5.6至7.5分),其他任务4.1分(95% CI−0.7-0.7至10.0分) (prumation p=0.59 p=0.59),在以名称为基础的等级下为7.0分和11.6分(p=0.45 p=0.45),较宽的列表给出了p=0.54 p=0.54和p=0.60 p=0.60 p=0.60,GPT-5在分数或列表(p=0.22 p\geq 0.22)下没有区别. 因此,一个已知的名字既不容易完成任务,也不保护它不受减少的影响,因此通过这些名字召回并不能解释我们的结果。 所标出的任务也是比较复杂的,因此这种比较不能排除名字的微小效果.

blocks.en: Appendix N Truncation
blocks.zh: 附录 N

blocks.en: Setup. A random name such as Bvwcdylhaazalut splits into many short tokens, so a renamed specification has more tokens, 1,630 on average against 1,457 for the original. The fine-tuned models stop at 1,024 new tokens, so a renamed output is more likely to be cut off and fail, which could lower correctness after renaming without any role for memory. We count the outputs that reach the limit or lack the closing line of a module, and we repeat the analysis on the tasks with no such output in any condition.
blocks.zh: 设相. Bvwcdylhaazalut等随机取名会分出许多个短符号,因此被重新命名的规格会有更多的符号,平均1,630个,而原作1,457个. 微调后的模型以1,024个新令牌起止,因此更名后输出更可能被切断并被失败,这可能会降低重命名后的正确度而没有任何内存角色. 我们计算一个模块达到极限或缺乏收尾线的产出,我们重复分析在任何条件下没有这种产出的任务。

blocks.en: Findings. Truncated outputs make up 16.9% and 13.5% of the original outputs of the models trained on half A and half B, and 18.7% and 16.9% of the renamed ones. Truncation is slightly more frequent in the renamed condition. On the 43/90 tasks with no truncated output in any condition, the renaming cost on unseen tasks is 9.8 points (95% CI 3.7 to 16.3), so the renaming cost persists on tasks with no truncated outputs. The difference in differences on these tasks is 7.4 points (95% CI 0.0 to 15.3), with an interval that reaches 0. The 43 tasks are not a random sample, because they are the shorter ones, and shorter specifications may be easier to memorize. The difference in differences is positive in every analysis, and its interval excludes 0 only under the name-based grade, so on correctness the evidence that renaming removes the gain from exposure is weak.
blocks.zh: 发现 在半A和半B培训的模型原始产出中,短产占16.9%和13.5%,被重新命名的模型占18.7%和16.9%。 在被重新命名的状态下,截断频率略高. 443/90任务无论在何种情况下都不得截断产出,未见任务重命名成本为9.8分(95% CI 3.7至16.3),因此重命名成本持续用于没有截断产出的任务. 在这些任务上的差异是7.4分(95% CI 0.0到15.3),间隔会达到0.43分。 43个任务不是随机抽样,因为它们是较短的,较短的规格可能更容易被记住。 差异差异在每一次分析中都是正的,其间距仅在以名称为主的分级下排除了0,因此为了正确,重命名去除接触后收益的证据是薄弱的.

blocks.en: Appendix O Specification-Only Exposure
blocks.zh: 附 录 O 规格-仅限接触

blocks.en: Setup. In task-pair exposure, a seen specification appears in training next to its test description, so we also train a second pair of models with the same split, training settings, and 292 shared description-specification pairs. Each half of the test set enters training as the raw .tla file alone, with no description and no prompt. We call this a specification-only exposure. We test and grade these models in the same way. A model that learns from public repositories sees a specification file in the same way, so this arm measures the same three quantities under the kind of exposure that contamination usually produces.
blocks.zh: 设相. 在任务-pair曝光中,在测试描述旁边的训练中出现了一个可见的规格,因此我们也训练了第二对具有相同分解,训练设置的模型,以及292个共享的规格规格对. 每半个测试集作为生的.tla文件单独进入训练,没有描述,也没有及时. 我们称这仅仅是个细节 我们以同样的方式测试这些模型。 从公共储存库中吸取教训的模型以同样的方式看到一个规格文件,因此这个臂能测量污染通常产生的接触种类下的同三量.

blocks.en: Findings. With the original descriptions, the seen model is correct on 14.2% of samples and the unseen model on 11.6%, an exposure effect of 2.7 points whose interval includes 0. On unseen tasks, renaming costs 0.4 points (95% CI − 3.6 -3.6 to 4.4) and the difference in differences is 2.7 points with an interval that includes 0. On correctness all three effects in this arm have intervals that include 0 (see Table O.1 ). On the likelihood of the reference, renaming removes part of the gain in this arm too, with a difference in differences of 0.08 (95% CI 0.07 to 0.10). On the tokens outside the renamed identifiers it is 0.04 (95% CI 0.03 to 0.05) and positive for 88/110 tasks. Correctness in this experiment stays between 11.6% and 14.2%, which leaves little room to measure a decrease. The seen model assigns the higher log-likelihood to the reference for 106/110 tasks.
blocks.zh: 发现 根据原始描述,14.2%的样本的可见模型是正确的,11.6%的未见模型是正确的,2.7分的暴露效应包括: 在隐形任务中,重命名成本为0.4分(95% CI − 3.6-3.6至4.4分),差异为2.7分,间隔包括: 0. 在正确性方面,这一臂中的所有三种效果都有间隔,包括0(见表O.1)。 关于引用的可能性,更名也会去除这只手臂的部分收益,差额为0.08(95% CI 0.07至0.10). 在重新命名的识别器以外的标志上是0.04(95% CI 0.03至0.05),88/110任务为正数。 这一实验的正确度保持在11.6%至14.2%之间,这几乎没有衡量下降的空间。 可见的模型为106/110任务指定了更高的对数相似度.

blocks.en: Appendix P Disagreements Between the Two Grades
blocks.zh: 附录P 分歧 在两个年级之间

blocks.en: The two grades disagree in both directions. Of the 450 Opus 4.8 samples per condition, 47 original and 71 renamed samples pass only the behavior-based grade, and 17 and 8 pass only the name-based grade. Behavior-only passes are mostly outputs that miss a hidden name. Reading the specifications behind the name-only passes shows that some describe different behavior. In one task the outputs fix a flag that the reference leaves free in the initial state, and in others an action differs. The name-based grade accepts them because TLC checks the outputs’ own invariants. The other name-only passes come from limits of the behavior-based grade. These outputs 1 encode a value differently, such as TRUE and FALSE for the 0 and 1 of the reference, 2 declare an extra constant or derive one that the reference declares or 3 write the specification formula in a form the grader does not parse. Most GPT-5 name-only passes come from one task with the boolean encoding. If every name-only pass counts as correct, which also credits the outputs with different behavior, the decrease for Opus 4.8 is 5.1 points (95% CI 0.4 to 10.2), half of the 10.4-point decrease under the name-based grade, and for GPT-5 it is 0.4 points (95% CI − 3.1 -3.1 to 4.0). The 90% interval of the Opus 4.8 decrease runs from − 0.2 -0.2 to 6.7 points. Its upper end exceeds the 5-point margin, so the data do not rule out an effect on Opus 4.8.
blocks.zh: 两个年级在两个方向上都存在分歧. 每个条件的450个Opus 4.8个样本中,47个原始和71个被更名的样本只通过行为分级,17个和8个只通过取名分级. 行为唯一通行证大多是缺少隐藏名称的输出. 阅读"唯名"通行证后面的规格显示,有些人描述了不同的行为. 在一项任务中,产出固定了参考文献在初始状态中留下的一面旗帜,而在另一些任务中,一个动作是不同的。 基于名的等级接受它们,因为 TLC 检查产出本身的变量。 另一种只取名的通行证来自行为等级的限制. 这些输出 1 编码了一个不同的值, 如 TRUE 和 FALSE 对参考文献 0 和 1 , 2 声明一个额外的常数或得出一个参考文献声明的常数或3 将规格公式写入一个平分器不分析的形式. 大部分的GPT-5只取名出自一个带有布尔编码的任务. 如果每个只取名的传出数都算正确,这也算出表现不同的输出,那么Opus 4.8的下降为5.1分(95% CI 0.4到10.2),在取名的分数下减少10.4分的一半,而GPT-5的下降为0.4分(95% CI − 3.1-3.1到4.0). Opus 4.8下降的90%间隔从−0.2-0.2到 6.7分. 其上端超过了5分比值,因此数据不排除对Opus 4.8的影响.

blocks.en: Appendix R Meaningful Names
blocks.zh: 附录R 名称

blocks.en: Setup. Random names might lower correctness because they remove the information that readable names carry, so we built a third condition to test this. Claude Opus 4.8 proposes a new meaningful name for each identifier and we apply and re-verify the renaming in the same way as the random one. We built these maps for the first 100 tasks of the test set, before it grew to 111, and 77/100 pass SANY and TLC after renaming, so the meaningful condition has 77.
blocks.zh: 设相. 随机名称可能会降低正确性,因为它们删除了可读名称携带的信息,所以我们建立了第三个条件来测试这个. Claude Opus 4.8为每个识别符提出了一个新的有意义的名称,我们以与随机命名相同的方式应用并重新验证了更名. 我们为测试集的前100项任务绘制了这些地图,后来发展到111个,77/100在更名后通过SANY和TLC,因此有意义的条件有77个.

blocks.en: Name-based grade. On the 77 tasks with a valid meaningful renaming, Opus 4.8 is correct on 30.1% of samples with the original descriptions, on 19.7% with random names, and on 20.0% with meaningful names. The difference between random and meaningful names is − 0.3 -0.3 points (95% CI − 2.3 -2.3 to 1.6 1.6 ). Its 90% interval runs from − 2.1 -2.1 to 1.3 1.3 and lies inside the margin of 5 points, so under the name-based grade the two renamings are equivalent, since both replace the same hidden names. For GPT-5, random and meaningful names give the same rate, 7.3%, on the 77 tasks with both renamings.
blocks.zh: 以名为分. 关于具有有效有意义的更名的77个任务,Opus 4.8正确指30.1%的样本有原始描述,19.7%有随机名称,20.0%有有意义的名称. 随机和有意义的名称的区别为-0.3-0.3分(95% CI − 2.3-2.3到 1.6 1.6分). 其90%的间隔从− 2.1-2.1到1.3 1.3,并位于5分的比分以内,因此在以名称为基础的等级下,两个更名是等同的,因为两者都替换了相同的隐藏名称. 对于GPT-5,随机和有意义的名字给出了同样的比例,7.3%,在77项任务上,两者都重名.

blocks.en: Behavior-based grade. For Opus 4.8, the meaningful renaming is valid on 61 of these tasks. On them, the behavior-based rate with meaningful names is 37.7%, 1.3 points (95% CI − 3.6 -3.6 to 6.2) below the rate of 39.0% with random names. The upper end exceeds the margin of 5 points, so under the behavior-based grade the comparison of the two renamings is inconclusive. On the 61 tasks with a meaningful renaming, GPT-5 is correct on 10.8% with random names and 11.1% with meaningful names.
blocks.zh: 行为分等. 对Opus 4.8来说,有意义的更名对其中61个任务有效. 在他们身上,有名有实的行为率是37.7%,1.3分(95% CI − 3.6-3.6至 6.2分)低于39.0%的随机取名率. 上端超过5分的比分,因此在以行为为主的分级下,两个更名的比较没有定论. 在61项有意义的更名任务上,GPT-5对10.8%的随机取名和11.1%的有意义的取名是正确的.
